title: Seed-Reinitialized Bounded Optimization with Damped Step Size
scientific_hypothesis: Reinitializing the optimizer from iteration 05's best candidate (target_score 0.7407) with thickness bounds restricted to 45-120 nm and 50% reduced step size will recover or exceed the iteration 05 performance while eliminating the >140 nm thickness drift that caused iteration 08 degradation.
design_principle: Use verified high-performing thickness profile as optimization seed; enforce strict bounds to prevent drift into non-productive thickness regimes; reduce step size to avoid overshooting local optima in the decoupled spectral response regime.
proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating stack starting with HfO2 on fused silica substrate, ending with SiO2 at air interface. Exact sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 800-1500 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 200-400 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds 45-120 nm compatible with standard deposition monitoring
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for coherent multilayer interference
Gradient-based thickness optimization with bounded variables
Seed initialization from previously verified high-performing candidate
expected_advantages: Faster convergence from verified seed point
Elimination of thickness drift beyond productive regime
known_risks: May converge to same local optimum as iteration 05 without improvement
Tight bounds may prevent discovery of better solutions outside 45-120 nm range
Reduced step size may require more optimization iterations
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Initialize thicknesses from the iteration 05 best candidate: [94.52, 44.39, 105.43, 125.49, 60.29, 139.57, 57.24, 132.67, 118.56, 65.78, 125.97, 50.46, 126.63, 57.34, 121.89, 87.85, 135.60, 58.91, 115.89, 87.90, 116.43, 63.74, 72.20, 76.02] nm. Apply strict thickness bounds of 45-120 nm to all layers (clip initial values outside bounds to nearest bound). Use gradient_thickness optimizer with step size reduced to 50% of default value. Spectral objectives: maximize mean transmittance over 800-1500 nm band, maximize mean reflectance over 200-400 nm band. Assume normal incidence, unpolarized light. Evaluate robustness with ±15 nm absolute normal thickness tolerance. Total layer count fixed at 24. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 200-400 nm, 800-1500 nm. soft objectives: High transmission in 800-1500 nm band; High reflection in 200-400 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low transmission in 200-400 nm band; Low reflection in 800-1500 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layers <= 30; Materials limited to HfO2 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Reset optimizer using iteration 05 best candidate (score 0.7407) as seed; restrict bounds to 45-120 nm to eliminate >140 nm drift observed in iteration 08; reduce step size by 50% per feedback directives to enforce gentler convergence.
